text:
elaine (product): quick sync — need a concise, contract-ready acceptance runbook for enterprise compliance (audit export, BYOK/KMS, retention lanes). customers asking for measurable tests.
tom (eng): propose MVP scope: cloud-KMS BYOK handshake, 90d hot index with on-demand NDJSON export, tenant retention flag + TTL job. keep cold archive out of MVP.
mina (security): add mandatory fields in every audit row: request_id, timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_version, kms_key_ref. Also require key-rotation events and attestation_token when available.
raj (sales): two pilots want this: LedgerBank (requires HSM attestation) and ShopCo (OK with cloud-KMS + 90d). LedgerBank will accept partner-attestation. Need timeline and acceptance tests for SOW.
cecilia (custeng): ShopCo needs fast forensic exports for recent traffic (<15m) and a sample export endpoint for legal review. They can accept phased delivery.
elaine (product): draft acceptance tests: 1) BYOK handshake: POST /v1/keystore/handshake -> returns handshake_id; verify audit row with kms_key_ref + handshake_status. 2) Fast-path export: GET /v1/audit/export?tenant=X&start=&end=&sample=100 -> first page <60s, NDJSON rows include mandatory fields. 3) Retention enforcement: set tenant retention=7y; run TTL job -> export shows tombstone marker and prior chain-of-custody preserved.
tom (eng): implementation notes: fast-path <60s requires hot index for 90d; 7y will be cold/paginated and slower. we'll provide cost delta and opt-in billing for long retention.
mina (security): for LedgerBank partner-attestation, acceptance requires attestation_token present in handshake audit row. I'll add regression tests for rotation and proof-of-deletion semantics.
legal-bot: ticket COMP-90001 created: "Acceptance runbook: BYOK + audit export + retention lanes" assigned to product/eng/security/legal.
elaine (product): next steps: tom + mina to draft tech-spec + test harness by EOW; legal to draft SOW acceptance language; raj to prioritize pilots. keep Phase A tight.
